entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Sorry for messaging you all[n]this early in the morning.
entries.uk: Вибачте, що пишу вам усім[n]так рано-вранці.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It seems my father will[n]be holding an urgent press[n]conference.

entries.en: I guess Okumura finally had his change[n]of heart.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That has to at least lift some of the burden[n]on Haru's shoulders.
entries.uk: Це має бодай трохи полегшити[n]тягар на плечах Хару.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Congrats!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: When is that going to be?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: 8 pm tonight.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder if he'll talk about[n]the mental shutdowns.
entries.uk: Цікаво, чи скаже він щось[n]про психічні відключення.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Where should we watch it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why don't we get[n]together beforehand?
Sounds good.
Is something on your mind?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't really have a reason[n]for meeting up, but it still[n]might prove beneficial.
entries.uk: Особливої причини збиратися[n]я не маю, проте це все одно[n]може стати в пригоді.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Anyway, how does the Shujin[n]Academy rooftop sound?
entries.uk: До речі, як вам дах[n]Академії Сюдзін?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I actually happen to have[n]some business up there.
entries.uk: Я, власне, саме маю[n]там деякі справи.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sounds good to me. It's been[n]ages since I was last there.
entries.uk: Я за. Сто років[n]там не була.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait... The school?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba, make sure you come in[n]through the front entrance.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: See you all there after school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm? Wait, where's Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...If he's still asleep at this point, he's[n]definitely going to be late for school.
entries.uk: ...Якщо він досі спить, то точно[n]спізниться до школи.
